sections.html: Prefixes (les préfixes) are added to the beginning of a word to change its meaning. Knowing them lets you understand hundreds of new words.

sections.heading: Negation / opposite
sections.html:
Prefix Meaning Examples
in- / im- / il- / ir- not inutile, impossible, illégal, irrégulier, inconnu
dé- / dés- / dis- undo, opposite défaire (undo), désagréable, désordre, déshabiller, disparaître
mal- / mé- / més- badly malheureux, malhonnête, mécontent, mésentente
a- / an- without anormal, apolitique, analphabète
non- non- non-fumeur, non-violence
anti- against antivirus, antidépresseur
contre- counter contredire, contrepartie

(im- before b, m, p; il- before l; ir- before r.)

sections.heading: Repetition / return
sections.html:
Prefix Meaning Examples
re- / ré- / r- again, back refaire, relire, réécrire, revenir, rentrer, rappeler

sections.heading: Time / order
sections.html:
Prefix Meaning Examples
pré- before prévoir, préhistoire, prédire
post- after postdater, post-scriptum
avant- before avant-hier, avant-garde
après- after après-demain, après-midi
ex- former ex-mari, ex-président

sections.heading: Quantity / degree
sections.html:
Prefix Meaning Examples
sur- / super- / hyper- / ultra- over, above, very surpoids, surprendre, supermarché, hypersensible, ultrarapide
sous- / hypo- under sous-sol, sous-estimer, hypothermie
extra- outside / extremely extraordinaire, extraterrestre
mono- / uni- one monologue, uniforme
bi- / di- two bilingue, bicyclette
tri- three triangle, trimestre
multi- / poly- many multinational, polyglotte
demi- / semi- / mi- half demi-heure, semi-finale, mi-temps

sections.heading: Place / direction
sections.html:
Prefix Meaning Examples
inter- between international, interdire
trans- across transport, transatlantique
en- / em- into, put in emporter, emballer (wrap), enterrer (bury)
ex- / é- out exporter, émigrer
co- / con- / com- with, together coopérer, colocataire (roommate), compatriote
auto- self automobile, autobiographie, autodidacte
télé- far téléphone, télétravail
para- protection against parapluie, parachute

exercises.instruction: Give the opposite or new word using a prefix:

exercises.prompt: What do these mean? *sous-estimer, bilingue, colocataire, avant-hier, surpoids.*
exercises.answer: to underestimate, bilingual, roommate, the day before yesterday, overweight.
